sections.title: I. OBSERVATION
sections.instructions: Observe the room. Fill one bubble per question. Close the booklet, then carry this section to the optical reader by the teacher's desk. All responses must be recorded before insertion.

questions.prompt: What time is shown on the classroom clock?
questions.examinerNote: Compare the hour hand with the minute hand.

questions.prompt: How many large windows are on the left wall when facing the board?
questions.examinerNote: Count window frames, not panes of glass.

questions.prompt: Which word is printed largest on the examination notice?
questions.examinerNote: The notice is posted beside the classroom board.

sections.title: II. VERIFICATION
sections.instructions: The room has not changed. Read each question carefully. If an observation seems impossible, close the booklet and check it before continuing.

questions.prompt: Are you alone in this room?
questions.examinerNote: RECOUNT. Your presence has already been included.

questions.prompt: What color is the shirt of the person sitting behind you?
questions.changedPrompt: What color is the shirt hanging on the wall?
questions.examinerNote: The wording of this question has not been revised.

questions.prompt: Which room number appears on the entrance door?
questions.examinerNote: The number is fixed to the inside of the door.

sections.title: III. ALLOCATION
sections.instructions: Consult the retained attendance record. Account for the available workstations. After insertion, remain seated until the reader releases your sheet.

questions.prompt: Which workstation can be removed from the attendance record?
questions.examinerNote: The selected space will be made available.
responseNotes: Workstation 03 has been released from the inventory.
Workstation 06 has been released from the inventory.
Workstation 08 has been released from the inventory.
No vacancy selected. Administrative allocation: workstation 06.

questions.prompt: What color is the pencil on your examination desk?
Where do the classroom announcements come from?
questions.examinerNote: Do not respond to an announcement unless your name is called.

sections.title: IV. RETENTION
sections.instructions: Use the record you retained. Answer from memory where directed. The present arrangement must not influence your recollection.

questions.prompt: How many student desks were here when you arrived?
questions.examinerNote: The inventory was checked before your arrival.

questions.prompt: Which shape is printed above the classroom board?
questions.examinerNote: INVALID RESPONSE. No correction has been made by the reader.

questions.prompt: Whose name appears on the retained attendance record?
questions.examinerNote: An absent candidate must not be marked as present.

sections.title: V. RELEASE
sections.instructions: Compare the current clock with your first response. Retain the carbon copy. Designate one record for release. The remaining record will stay on file.

questions.prompt: What time is shown on the classroom clock now?
questions.examinerNote: Your earlier observation has been retained without amendment.

questions.prompt: Whose answers appear on the retained copy?
questions.examinerNote: The original and retained copies bear the same responses.

questions.prompt: Which record do you authorize for release?
questions.examinerNote: The designation has been entered. Authorization cannot be withdrawn.
